title: Google integrates Nano Banana 2 into Google Earth via a new Create Image button, letting users prompt to create infographics or visual alterations of locations (David Gewirtz/ZDNET)
summary: David Gewirtz / ZDNET: Google integrates Nano Banana 2 into Google Earth via a new Create Image button, letting users prompt to create infographics or visual alterations of locations — ZDNET's key takeaways — Google Earth can now generate AI images with Nano Banana. — The tool is entertaining, but weak for serious geographic work.
contentText:
David Gewirtz / ZDNET :

Google integrates Nano Banana 2 into Google Earth via a new Create Image button, letting users prompt to create infographics or visual alterations of locations   —  ZDNET's key takeaways  — Google Earth can now generate AI images with Nano Banana.  — The tool is entertaining, but weak for serious geographic work.
